description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LuxuryAirplane" name="Luxury Airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureParts" name="Manufacture configured parts">
      <bpmn:documentation>Manufacturing includes the configured bar and other specified parts; for example, a vodka bar is made by the Russian team and a whiskey bar by the Irish team.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to company and customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ConfirmedDelivery" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ManufactureParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_CreateProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="End_ConfirmedDelivery"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_LuxuryAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_DeliveryConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
